prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals (social vs. TV ads), budget, creative style, need for synthetic presenters, languages, and how automated you want the workflow. Below are best-in-class options by common use-case to help you pick quickly.

Top choices by use-case

- Best for fast social ads & templates: Canva (video), Promo.com, Biteable
  - Why: tons of ad-ready templates, quick editing, stock footage, easy resizing for platforms.
  - Pick these if you want speed and low learning curve.

- Best for text-to-video & turning long content into short ads: Pictory, Lumen5
  - Why: automatically creates short videos from scripts, blogs or long videos and adds captions and music.
  - Pick these if you convert blog posts/webinars into ad clips.

- Best for AI presenters/synthetic spokespeople: Synthesia, HeyGen (Movio/Elai.io in same category)
  - Why: realistic avatar presenters, multi-language voice & lip sync — great for product demos, explainer ads.
  - Pick these if you want a talking “human” without booking talent.

- Best for advanced generative visuals & creative editing: Runway, Descript
  - Why: generative video tools, text-based editing, background replacement, advanced effects.
  - Pick these if you need cutting-edge visuals or fast iterative editing.

- Best for scalable personalized video ads: Rephrase.ai / Idomoo / SundaySky (enterprise)
  - Why: high-volume personalized videos for CRM/retargeting.
  - Pick these for large-scale, 1:1 personalization campaigns.

- Best all-around lightweight maker: InVideo / FlexClip / Animoto
  - Why: flexible templates, decent AI features, good value for small teams.

How to choose quickly
1. Define priorities: speed, creative control, realism (avatars), personalization, multi-language support, budget.
2. Test 2–3 tools with trials or free tiers using a real script and final ad specs.
3. Evaluate output quality, template/library, voiceovers, captioning, aspect ratios, export rights, and price.

My short recommendations
- If you want the fastest route to social ads with excellent templates and brand controls: try Canva (video) or Promo.com.
- If you need a synthetic spokesperson or multilingual voiceovers: try Synthesia or HeyGen.
- If you need to auto-create short ad clips from long form content: try Pictory.

If you tell me your budget, ad length, platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), and whether you want a real-looking presenter, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a short workflow for your use case.
